## One shortcode, one animation

The scene is a built Canvas Commons file, given relative to `dist/`:

```markdown
{{{< canvas-commons ./animations/src/smoke.js fullscreen=true >}}}
```

<!-- The next slide needs the starter's scene built first: copy template/animations here and run `npm --prefix animations install && npm --prefix animations run build`. Without it the player stays empty. -->

## The smoke scene {.hidetitle}

{{< canvas-commons ./animations/src/smoke.js fullscreen=true >}}

## Options

| Option | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| `fullscreen=true` | Fill the slide |
| `width=50%` | Width of the player |
| `loop=false` | Stop on the last frame |
| `auto=false` | Do not start on arrival |
| `background=true` | Put it behind the slide's content |
